India and Japan hold strategic talks in Tokyo, announce 2027 partnership celebrations

Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh travelled to Tokyo where Jaishankar met former Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida ahead of the India‑Japan 2+2 dialogue, reviewed defence cooperation and hailed the strategic partnership, announcing that the two countries will mark the partnership with Shared Horizons celebrations in 2027.
